notes: The manual does not give breadboard columns; columns 10/11/12 (bottom bank, row f for the pot, row g for wires) are estimated from the circuit image.
Potentiometer outer pins: GND side to Arduino GND, VCC side to 5V; middle pin (wiper, SIG) to A0, as in the schematic.
The USB cable to the computer for serial communication is not drawn in the circuit image and is omitted.
Which outer pin goes to GND and which to 5V is arbitrary per the manual; the image shows black on the left pin and red on the right pin.
